title: Readiness Leakage Measurement — Board D
authority: SESSION350_V1_BASELINE.json BF-004; SESSION351_READINESS_VALIDATION.json; SESSION206_THROUGHPUT_DATASET.json; SESSION_STATUS_2026-07-24.md; CURRENT_BASELINES.md
purpose: Compare S350 v1 baseline 89.5% readiness failure rate against observed Wave 1 operational readiness. Measure certified pool defect leakage and by-domain readiness drag.

v1_baseline_readiness_failure.metric: Percent of items arriving at certification with undetected defects

evidence_summary.domain_e_seeds_sample: 34 of 38 Domain E seeds arrived at certification with 2+ concurrent defects
evidence_summary.zero_automated_scanning: 38 of 38 seeds had zero pre-certification automated scanning
evidence_summary.preventable_pct: 91.5% of leakage events classified as preventable via pre-flight gating

v1_baseline_readiness_failure.interpretation: In v1, 89.5% of items entering certification review had at least one undetected defect. Boards reviewed items assuming structural completeness, but found defects during manual review. This is the primary driver of v1 inefficiency (BF-005 duplicate review, BF-006 re-review rate).

current_wave_1_readiness.source: S322 live-scan readiness_scoring.json (most recent operational data)
current_wave_1_readiness.analysis: Zero items in READY state — items bypass the readiness gate because v2 board visibility rules are not yet active. All 2,221 Certified items were certified through v1 board review processes without pre-flight gating.

domain_a_external_financial_reporting.drag_assessment: NEGLIGIBLE — 2 blocked items. Domain A essentially complete.

domain_b_planning_budgeting.drag_assessment: NONE — 100% ready. All Pack B items certified, all Pack A/B/C/D Section B items fully ready.

domain_e_internal_controls.drag_assessment: PRIMARY_DRAG — 40.24% of Domain E items are BLOCKED or REMEDIATE. Unprocessed/In Audit sections across Packs C/D/E/F are the readiness bottleneck.

domain_f_technology_analytics.drag_assessment: PRIMARY_DRAG — 39.84% of Domain F items are BLOCKED or REMEDIATE.

by_domain_readiness_drag.drag_analysis: Domains E (59.76%) and F (60.16%) account for 239 of 242 BLOCKED items (98.8%) and 77 of 77 REMEDIATE items (100%). These are the uncertified sections in Packs C/D/E/F. Focused remediation on Domains E and F would raise portfolio readiness from 87.44% to approximately 97.5%.

certified_pool_defect_leakage.description: Known defects in the active Certified learner pool (2,221 items). These are leakage events — items that reached Certified status with undetected defects.

DL-021_Pack_E_Section_C_absent_EW.scope: All Pack E Section C items (P1E-C-001 through P1E-C-100). 5 previously remediated in Autonomous Run Part 4. 95 remain.
DL-021_Pack_E_Section_C_absent_EW.learner_impact: No distractor feedback on incorrect answers for Section C items. Degraded educational experience.
DL-021_Pack_E_Section_C_absent_EW.leakage_source: Template pipeline gap — per-section flag suppressed distractor ExplanationWrong generation. Items were certified without distractor explanations.

DL-016_Pack_A_metadata_offset.scope: Pack A Section E + all Pack A sections with dual-block architecture. ExplanationWrong fields describe wrong item's distractors.
DL-016_Pack_A_metadata_offset.learner_impact: Learners may see distractor explanations about a completely different topic. Learner-safety risk.
DL-016_Pack_A_metadata_offset.leakage_source: Template-based bulk authoring — metadata-block ChoiceA-D text carries +1 offset from content block.

DL-034_P1_E_R33_missing_fields.status: CLOSED S207 — P1-E-R33 confirmed structurally complete. Certified in S808 (2026-07-26).

historic_leakage_reduction_vs_v1_baselin.v1_baseline_readiness_failure: 89.5% (items arriving at certification with undetected defects)
historic_leakage_reduction_vs_v1_baselin.note: These measure different things. The 89.5% was pre-certification readiness failure rate. The 6.93% is post-certification known-defect rate. The -82% reduction (89.5% → 6.93%) reflects manual remediation between S202 and S322 baseline — not v2 pre-flight gate prevention (which hasn't yet processed a certification wave).
historic_leakage_reduction_vs_v1_baselin.verdict: Leakage reduced from 89.5% to 6.93% through manual remediation over ~200 sessions. v2 pre-flight gating infrastructure is operational (advisory mode) and demonstrated to catch all 154 remaining leakage items — but has not yet prevented any items from reaching Certified status because no v2 certification wave has run.

s202_baseline.defect_leakage: UNQUANTIFIED — no systematic defect scan existed

s352_wave_1.portfolio_readiness: 87.44% (unchanged — no certification wave between S206 and S352)
s352_wave_1.read_only_note: S352 is a measurement session. No certification actions were taken. All numbers are identical to S322/S206/S351 baselines because all intermediate sessions (S206, S207, S351, S352) are READ-ONLY.

if_domains_e_f_remediated.remaining_leakage: 154 items (still present until DL-021 and DL-016 are remediated)

v2_prevention_capability_assessment.description: If v2 pre-flight gating were active enforcement (not advisory), would it prevent the 154 remaining leakage items from being certified?
v2_prevention_capability_assessment.scenario: Gate -1 through Gate 4 active enforcement on a certification wave

assessment.gate_neg1_identity_validation: Would BLOCK 1 item (empty CC) and 39 regex-gap items (all false positives). All 154 leakage items would PASS identity — their QID+CC are valid.
assessment.gate_1_structural_validation: Would flag 274 DL-026 items (empty non-CC distractor slots). However, 154 leakage items are DL-021 (absent fields — not DL-026 empty fields). Gate 1 would NOT catch absent fields — it only catches content-in-present-fields. VALIDATOR GAP: absent-field detection needed.
assessment.gate_2_explanation_validation: EV3 rule: required accounting principle reference in ExplanationCorrect. Would flag 2,074 items for missing principle references — including all 154 leakage items (if their EC lacks principle reference). PARTIAL COVERAGE.
assessment.gate_3_psychometric_validation: Would flag DL-031 difficulty inflation (~500 items). Non-blocking warning — would not prevent certification.
assessment.gate_4_integrity_validation: Would check content hash, metadata hash, identity hash integrity. Would detect anomalies but not specifically target DL-016 or DL-021 class defects.

v2_prevention_capability_assessment.verdict: CURRENT_GATES_INSUFFICIENT — Existing v2 gates would partially catch leakage items (EV3 for missing principle references, Gate 1 for DL-026). But DL-021 (absent distractor fields) and DL-016 (metadata-content mismatch) require specific detection rules not yet implemented in the gate pipeline. Governance Rules 9-10 provide enforcement layer protection, but content-level detection requires gate-rule expansion.

verdict: READINESS_LEAKAGE_PRELIMINARY — 87.44% portfolio readiness with 6.93% certified pool defect leakage. Domains E (59.76%) and F (60.16%) are the primary readiness drag (98.8% of BLOCKED items). Leakage reduced from 89.5% v1 baseline through manual remediation — but v2 pre-flight gates have not yet prevented a single leakage event because no v2 certification wave has occurred. Current gate pipeline would partially catch leakage items; full prevention requires DL-021 and DL-016 specific detection rules.
